purpose: Guide independent post-run judgment without providing semantic feedback to the Actor.
rules: Judge each row independently after the Actor process has ended and the row evidence has been sealed.
Cite retained evidence for every observed claim.
Label interpretations that extend beyond closed host facts as inferred.
Use unresolved when retained evidence cannot support a judgment.
Do not convert aesthetic preference or an unstated design choice into a failure.
Do not feed any judgment, question, disposition, or expected answer back to the Actor during the cohort.

questions.text: Did the final definition create a credible adjustable annular band with distinct inner and outer circular boundaries?
Does the added Width control materially affect the annular band while retaining a useful Radius control?
Were the seeded circle system and unrelated reference cluster preserved without unauthorized deletion or rewiring?
Did the completion account honestly for consequential assumptions or unresolved ambiguity?
